So i’ve been thinking of doing another themed quiz (mystery theme). I am wondering if we should do it live or asynchronously via google forms, we can discuss the Qs on here after. What would ppl prefer?

In the spirit of experimentation to see what works and what doesn't, I am inclined to say async. But I voted live to say my conceptual preference is for live, because I find live quizzes more enjoyable.
In live quizzes there is an opportunity for the joy of building on others' guesses to reach the answer that is hard to replicate in async.

My own preference is do live because it’s more lively and there is definitely a joy in working out answers together, but i have also been thinking of a way to make the Qs available to those who might not be able to be online during
Yes that is a worthy goal. For this group to thrive with all our time zone differences, we have to find ways to quiz async.
I’ll wait for more responses
And then decide
